records.title: LightGlue: Local Feature Matching at Light Speed
records.reason: The primary abstract describes a deep neural network that matches local visual features across image pairs, with adaptive computation and improved memory/computation efficiency for sparse visual matching and latency-sensitive 3D reconstruction. Its task and system are computer vision, not LLM inference/serving or inference-time LLM compression/efficiency. Speed or efficiency claims for a non-LLM vision matcher are outside the stated scope.
records.body_check: The primary arXiv record and abstract were checked. They identify LightGlue as an image local-feature matcher, discuss efficiency in memory/computation and adaptive inference on easy image pairs, and name 3D reconstruction as an application. These are explicitly vision-model contributions rather than LLM inference or serving. Abstract-level exclusion is sufficient because the task domain is clear; full text was not reviewed.

records.title: Attention Augmented Convolutional Networks
records.reason: The primary abstract introduces a two-dimensional relative self-attention mechanism to augment convolutional networks for discriminative visual tasks, reporting image-classification and object-detection results while keeping parameter counts similar. It is an image-vision architecture contribution, not an LLM inference/serving system or an inference-time efficiency/compression method for LLMs. The mere use of self-attention is insufficient for scope inclusion.
records.body_check: The primary arXiv record and abstract were checked. They describe combining convolutional feature maps with two-dimensional self-attention for image classification and COCO object detection, with similar parameter counts and accuracy/mAP improvements. These task-performance results concern vision models and do not describe LLM inference, serving, or inference-time LLM efficiency. Abstract-level exclusion is sufficient because the scope mismatch is explicit; full text was not reviewed.
